title: Cubical and Superficial Expansion
topicTitle: Cubical expansion, superficial expansion and their relation with linear expansion
notes: **Superficial expansion:** area increase when heated. $\Delta A = A_0 \beta \Delta T$, where $\beta \approx 2\alpha$.
**Cubical expansion:** volume increase when heated. $\Delta V = V_0 \gamma \Delta T$, where $\gamma \approx 3\alpha$.
**Why the ratios:** volume depends on three dimensions, area on two, length on one. Each dimension expands by $\alpha$, so the combined effect multiplies the exponent.
**Liquids:** only cubical expansion is meaningful. $\gamma_{liquid} = \gamma_{solid} - \gamma_{container}$ for apparent expansion.
